en.longDescription:
Activepieces is an open-source workflow automation platform (Zapier alternative) with hundreds of integrations and AI actions.

Includes PostgreSQL and Redis. Set AP_FRONTEND_URL via SERVICE_URL_ACTIVEPIECES for webhooks. Register your admin account on first launch.

de.longDescription:
Activepieces ist eine Open-Source-Plattform zur Workflow-Automatisierung (Zapier-Alternative) mit Hunderten von Integrationen und KI-Aktionen.

Enthält PostgreSQL und Redis. Setze AP_FRONTEND_URL über SERVICE_URL_ACTIVEPIECES für Webhooks. Registriere beim ersten Start dein Admin-Konto.

fr.shortDescription: Plateforme open source d'automatisation de workflows
fr.longDescription:
Activepieces est une plateforme open source d'automatisation de workflows (alternative à Zapier) avec des centaines d'intégrations et d'actions IA.

Inclut PostgreSQL et Redis. Définissez AP_FRONTEND_URL via SERVICE_URL_ACTIVEPIECES pour les webhooks. Créez votre compte administrateur au premier lancement.

pt.shortDescription: Plataforma open-source de automação de fluxos de trabalho
pt.longDescription:
Activepieces é uma plataforma open-source de automação de fluxos de trabalho (alternativa ao Zapier) com centenas de integrações e ações de IA.

Inclui PostgreSQL e Redis. Defina AP_FRONTEND_URL via SERVICE_URL_ACTIVEPIECES para webhooks. Registre sua conta de administrador no primeiro acesso.
